register_count_writers.rule: REP A1 immediately following an admitted one-word A/A0/A1/A2 writer adds one period; B writers, nonzero gaps and two-word producers do not.

memory_arithmetic_count_writers.rule: REP A1 immediately following an admitted one-word A/A0/A1/A2 writer adds one period; B writers and nonzero gaps do not; covers native memory-load and arithmetic writers independently of the move-producer matrix.
memory_arithmetic_count_writers.anchor_attribution: Normal software step logs charge an adjacent ASR/REP hold at the ASR anchor and move/REP holds at REP; this is not a silicon stage assertion.

standalone_N4_writers.rule: Short/long immediate, X1 register and X-memory writers to N4 are observed by the next standalone N4 store; zero through three NOP gaps add only their nominal periods. No extra source hold is observed.
